name: Luan

attributes.attribute: god worshipped on the Isle of Man
the Manx form of Lugh or Lugos
an agricultural god honored at Lughnasa

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Luan was a god worshipped on the Isle of Man. There he was the form of the great deity known in other Celtic lands as Lugh or Lugos. People honored Luan as a god of farming and agriculture. His feast day fell on Lughnasa, the large Celtic celebration held on August the first to mark the harvest.

okr.objective: Document Luan as the Manx form of the god Lugh, an agricultural deity.
